notes: Every image prompt is paired with a text-only control asking a comparable question, so the cost of the image is a measured delta rather than a figure standing on its own.
Categories are named so the per-category tables put each pair side by side.
The image is dashboard.png, 1024x640, generated by make-test-image.py in this directory. Vision models tile an image into tokens by resolution, so results are specific to that size.
Only a multimodal model can run the image prompts. A text-only model will fail them, and the harness records that as a failure rather than a zero.
Prompt order matters: the harness measures the first prompt once as a cold run before the warm loop, so whichever prompt sits first is sent twice. Keep the ordering fixed when comparing runs.

Budgets are 768 rather than the text set's tighter ceilings: one of the multimodal models here reasons before answering and spends most of its allowance doing so, returning an empty answer under a smaller budget.
